scope: One CAPS03 normal-idle VFIO/OPAE entry and one retained-owner numerical case; implicit idle acquisition/enumeration FLRs included. No post-allocation cleanup, retries, PR, manual reset or active-transaction teardown.

review_correction.basis: Source-derived nominal accounting, not a corrected simulation or measured physical waveform.

operating_assumptions: Vendor clocks running after successful initialization; selected VF FLR does not gate/reset memory clocks.
No concurrent PR or device owner; freeze remains in reset/idle default.
Exact unchanged deployed image, same boot, bound modules/runtime and VF route.
required_live_preflight: Recheck selected module/artifact hashes and boot.
Recheck singleton VF ownership, binding and current initialized flags through the previously admitted static EMIF accessors.
Retain application and namespace on any post-spawn uncertainty; no automatic recovery.
